import json

import boto3


def fetch_db_secret(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    client = boto3.client("secretsmanager", region_name=config.get("region"))
    response = client.get_secret_value(SecretId=payload["secret_id"])
    secret_string = response["SecretString"]
    db_credentials = json.loads(secret_string)
    return {
        "username": db_credentials.get("username"),
        "password": db_credentials.get("password"),
        "host": db_credentials.get("host"),
        "port": db_credentials.get("port"),
        "dbname": db_credentials.get("dbname"),
    }

from google.cloud import aiplatform

def summarize_rotation_status(text: str, project_id: str, location: str) -> str:
    aiplatform.init(project=project_id, location=location)
    parameters = {
        "temperature": 0.2,
        "max_output_tokens": 256,
        "top_p": 0.95,
        "top_k": 40,
    }
    model = aiplatform.preview.language_models.TextGenerationModel.from_pretrained("gemini-pro")
    response = model.predict(f"Summarize the following secret rotation status notes:\n{text}", **parameters)
    return response.text

from google.cloud import aiplatform

def embed_audit_notes(text: str, project_id: str, location: str) -> list[float]:
    aiplatform.init(project=project_id, location=location)
    model = aiplatform.language_models.TextEmbeddingModel.from_pretrained("text-embedding-004")
    embeddings = model.predict([text])
    return embeddings[0].values

from google.cloud import translate_v3 as translate

def translate_runbook_notes(text: str, target_language_code: str, project_id: str) -> str:
    client = translate.TranslationServiceClient()
    location = "global"
    parent = f"projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}"

    response = client.translate_text(
        request={
            "parent": parent,
            "contents": [text],
            "mime_type": "text/plain",
            "target_language_code": target_language_code,
        }
    )

    return response.translations[0].translated_text
